labels.strain: Overstrain (tool wear x torque vs type limit)
labels.heat: Heat-dissipation margin (low temp. difference and low speed)

notes: Inputs are operating conditions only (tool wear, torque, speed, temperatures, machine type). The Machine failure / mode labels are NEVER inputs. Reference limits come from the published AI4I 2020 dataset description and are checked against this file's labels in Module 2 (rule agreement). The AI4I data is synthetic, so this is an operating-condition risk indicator, not a validated predictive-maintenance model.
